newsitem.title: NEPAL: Earthquake in Nepal, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake in Nepal, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.0 on the Richter scale shook the northern Nepali district of Rasuwa on Tuesday, but there was no immediate report of loss of life or property, officials said.
The National Seismological Centre said the epicentre of tremors at 3.13 a.m. (2128 GMT on Monday) was located at Sarsen village in Rasuwa about 100 km (60 miles) north of Kathmandu.
Residents said shocks were also experienced in Kathmandu.
